prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 20 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1105; do not mention it.)
text:
Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reported immediate neck pain radiating to the upper trapezius region and low back pain with stiffness on waking. No loss of consciousness was reported, and no head strike occurred. Initial examination documented reduced cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and pain with extension and rotation. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with intact sensation and symmetric reflexes in the upper and lower extremities.

Diagnoses were cervical strain and lumbar strain consistent with soft tissue injury from the collision. Treatment over the course of care included 20 visits consisting of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, posture education, and home exercise instruction. Pain was managed with conservative measures, and the patient was advised to avoid heavy lifting during the acute phase.

At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported substantial improvement in pain and function, with cervical and lumbar range of motion approaching baseline. Residual mild stiffness remains with prolonged sitting. Continued home exercise is recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur.
